parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the API group.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: StageName
parameters.description:
The name of the runtime environment. Valid values:

*   **RELEASE**
*   **PRE**
*   **TEST**

parameters.name: Visibility
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the API is public. Valid values:

*   **PUBLIC**: indicates that the API is public. If you set this parameter to PUBLIC, this API is displayed on the API List page in the console for all users after the API is published to the production environment.
*   **PRIVATE**: indicates that the API is private. If you set this parameter to PRIVATE, this API is not displayed in Alibaba Cloud Marketplace after the API group to which this API belongs is made available.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-purchased-apis --group-id d27ad517be5f4c95ac3631780a8f4d50 --stage-name RELEASE --api-id 3b81fd160f5645e097cc8855d75a1cf6 --api-name CZ_IP_database_query_API --visibility PUBLIC --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
